series_start_reason: Series starts 2015Q3, the first quarter with Strensiq sales (357 thousand; approvals in Japan and the EU preceded the U.S. approval of October 23, 2015, per the Q3 2015 release: 'Strensiq was also approved in the European Union, Japan and Canada').

unreported_quarters.2021Q3: Ownership change Alexion Pharmaceuticals to AstraZeneca; no full-quarter figure is published. AstraZeneca completed the acquisition of Alexion on 21 July 2021 and consolidated it from that date, so its third-quarter 2021 figure covers 21 July-30 September only; Alexion's last report is the 8-K of 2021-07-20 for the second quarter (Form 15-12G filed 2021-08-02). The first full AstraZeneca quarter is 2021Q4.

search_log: [Alexion piece] Listed every Alexion (CIK 0000899866) filing via data.sec.gov/submissions (recent + older pages): 259 8-K, 8 8-K/A, 75 10-Q, 25 10-K (all forms counted). Took every 8-K/8-K/A filed 2015-07 to 2021-08 whose items include 2.02, 9.01 or 7.01 and fetched every non-primary .htm exhibit via each filing's index.json; the Item 2.02 8-K of 2021-07-20 has no exhibit, so its primary document was read.

[Alexion piece] Row read from the first table of each quarterly release whose first cell is the brand or 'Total <brand>' (net product sales by product; worldwide total line), current three-month column first. Unit from the table header: thousands in the releases filed 2015-10 to 2016-10, millions from the 2016Q4 release (filed 2017-02-16) on.

[Alexion piece] 2021Q2 is from Alexion's 8-K of 2021-07-20 (revenue table in the body of the report, 'subject to our customary internal quarterly close procedures'), filed one day before AstraZeneca completed the acquisition; Form 15-12G filed 2021-08-02, so no 10-Q for the quarter exists.

[AstraZeneca piece] Listed every AstraZeneca (CIK 0000901832) filing via data.sec.gov/submissions: 1,620 6-K, 6 6-K/A, 24 20-F (all forms counted). Fetched the primary document of every 6-K filed 2021-10 to 2026-08 in the results months (Feb, Apr, May, Jul, Oct, Nov); the quarterly results announcements are the documents larger than 300 kB (one per quarter, 2021-11-12 to 2026-07-27).

[AstraZeneca piece] Each announcement prints year-to-date and quarter product-sales-by-region tables; the quarter table is the one used (World $m column). 2021Q3 (Alexion consolidated from 21 July 2021) is a stub and is not delivered.
